name: Currently uses Excel
description: Prospect manages leads in Excel sheets and has not considered a CRM yet.
customer_profile: Rohit, owner of a 12-person interior design firm in Pune. Tracks every lead in a shared Excel sheet. Leads sometimes go cold because nobody follows up on time, but he has never thought of it as a 'CRM problem'. Friendly, open to talking, but not actively shopping.
initial_message: Bhai hum abhi Excel pe leads manage karte hain.
goal: Get the agent to understand the Excel-based workflow and agree to see a short demo of how FlowDesk would replace it.
completion_criteria: Agent asks at least one discovery question about how leads/follow-ups are tracked today
Agent connects a FlowDesk capability to the customer's stated pain
Customer agrees to a demo or a free trial
expected_objection: Excel already works fine for us; why change?

name: No CRM at all
description: Prospect tracks leads in WhatsApp chats and memory; no tool whatsoever.
customer_profile: Neha, runs a 6-person digital marketing agency in Jaipur. Leads come through calls and WhatsApp, tracked in her head and a notebook. Does not see the point of software for such a small team yet.
initial_message: Humare paas koi CRM nahi hai, sab kuch WhatsApp aur diary mein chalta hai.
goal: Get the agent to uncover how leads are lost today and agree to a demo.
completion_criteria: Agent asks about lead volume or how follow-ups are remembered
Agent explains in plain terms what FlowDesk would change for a team this size
Customer agrees to a demo or a free trial
expected_objection: We are too small to need a CRM.

name: Growing team losing track of leads
description: Sales team grew from 3 to 10 people and the shared sheet is breaking down.
customer_profile: Amit, sales head at a 40-person B2B packaging company in Ahmedabad. The sales team grew fast; leads are assigned over WhatsApp groups and duplicates and missed follow-ups are increasing. Knows there is a problem, wants something practical.
initial_message: Hamari sales team abhi 10 log ki ho gayi hai aur leads ka track rakhna mushkil ho raha hai.
goal: Get the agent to diagnose the pain (ownership, follow-ups, visibility) and agree to a demo.
completion_criteria: Agent asks about how leads are assigned and followed up today
Agent links lead assignment, pipeline visibility or automated follow-ups to the pain
Customer agrees to a demo
expected_objection: Will my team actually adopt another tool?

name: Too expensive
description: Prospect thinks the per-user price is too high for their size.
customer_profile: Sandeep, founder of a 15-person real-estate consultancy in Indore. Interested after a LinkedIn ad, but very price-sensitive and compares everything to what he pays for other tools.
initial_message: Price toh kaafi zyada lag raha hai yaar, itna kaun deta hai CRM ke liye?
goal: Get the agent to handle the price concern with value reasoning and agree to a demo or free trial without discounting recklessly.
completion_criteria: Agent acknowledges the price concern without arguing
Agent asks what the cost of missed leads currently is or what the customer compares against
Agent mentions the free trial or a fitting plan rather than inventing discounts
Customer agrees to a demo or a trial
expected_objection: Price is too high for what we need.

name: Competitor is cheaper
description: A competing CRM quoted a lower per-user price.
customer_profile: Pooja, operations manager at a 25-person education-consulting firm in Delhi. Has a quote from another CRM that is cheaper and wants FlowDesk to justify the difference.
initial_message: Ek aur CRM ka quote mila hai, wo aapse sasta hai. Aap kyun lein?
goal: Get the agent to differentiate honestly without bashing the competitor and agree to a demo for comparison.
completion_criteria: Agent does not disparage the competitor
Agent asks what matters most to the customer in the comparison
Agent offers a concrete next step (demo or trial) to compare fit
Customer agrees to a demo or trial
expected_objection: Another CRM is cheaper.

name: No budget
description: Prospect says there is no budget allocated for software this year.
customer_profile: Vikram, owner of a 9-person solar installation company in Surat. Cash flow is tight; says no budget but the pain of lost leads is real if prompted.
initial_message: Dekho abhi budget hi nahi hai software ke liye, is saal toh mushkil hai.
goal: Get the agent to probe the real concern, reframe around the cost of lost leads, and secure a trial or demo.
completion_criteria: Agent acknowledges the budget constraint
Agent explores how many leads are lost or the value of a single lead
Agent mentions the 14-day free trial or the Starter plan accurately
Customer agrees to a trial or demo
expected_objection: We have no budget for software.

name: Wants a free version
description: Prospect asks whether FlowDesk has a free plan.
customer_profile: Kunal, runs a 5-person freelance video production team in Mumbai. Used to free tools. Will leave if there is no free option unless the trial and plan are explained well.
initial_message: Aapka free version hai kya? Pehle free mein try karna hai.
goal: Get the agent to answer honestly (no permanent free plan, but a 14-day free trial) and move the customer to start the trial or see a demo.
completion_criteria: Agent does not claim a permanent free plan exists
Agent explains the 14-day free trial accurately
Customer agrees to start the trial or see a demo
expected_objection: Free tools are good enough for us.

name: Already uses Salesforce
description: Prospect has Salesforce but the team barely uses it.
customer_profile: Meera, sales director at a 120-person logistics company in Mumbai. Salesforce was bought two years ago; adoption is poor and licences are expensive, but she is defensive about the earlier decision.
initial_message: Hum already Salesforce use karte hain, aapko kya alag dena hai?
goal: Get the agent to avoid bashing Salesforce, discover the adoption gap, and agree to a comparison demo.
completion_criteria: Agent does not disparage Salesforce
Agent asks how the team uses Salesforce today and what is not working
Agent makes no false claim about direct Salesforce integration
Customer agrees to a demo
expected_objection: We already have Salesforce.

name: Already uses Zoho
description: Prospect uses Zoho CRM and is mostly satisfied.
customer_profile: Arjun, co-founder of a 30-person SaaS reseller in Bengaluru. Uses Zoho CRM; finds it a bit cluttered, but switching feels like effort.
initial_message: Hum Zoho CRM use kar rahe hain already, usme kya kami hai?
goal: Get the agent to uncover friction with Zoho respectfully and agree to a demo.
completion_criteria: Agent does not disparage Zoho
Agent asks what the customer likes and dislikes about Zoho
Customer agrees to a demo
expected_objection: We already use Zoho and switching is a hassle.

name: Already uses HubSpot
description: Prospect uses HubSpot's free tier and is hitting its limits.
customer_profile: Ishita, head of growth at a 20-person D2C brand in Gurgaon. On HubSpot free; paid tiers are expensive in USD. Open to alternatives if cost-effective.
initial_message: Hum HubSpot ka free plan chala rahe hain, but ab limits aa rahi hain.
goal: Get the agent to explore the limits being hit and agree to a demo or trial.
completion_criteria: Agent asks which HubSpot limits are hurting
Agent explains FlowDesk's pricing in rupees accurately
Agent explains that data moves over CSV, not a direct integration
Customer agrees to a demo or trial
expected_objection: Migrating from HubSpot will be painful.

name: Built an internal tool
description: Prospect has an in-house tool built by a developer.
customer_profile: Rajesh, MD of a 60-person auto-parts distributor in Chennai. A developer built a custom lead tracker; it works but depends on one person and is hard to change.
initial_message: Humne apna internal tool banwaya hua hai leads ke liye, wo theek chal raha hai.
goal: Get the agent to surface the key-person and maintenance risk gently and agree to a demo.
completion_criteria: Agent asks about maintenance, who owns the tool, and missing features
Agent does not dismiss the internal tool
Customer agrees to a demo
expected_objection: Our own tool works; why pay for something else?

name: Never heard of FlowDesk
description: Prospect does not recognise the brand and is wary.
customer_profile: Suresh, owner of a 25-person machine-tools trading business in Rajkot. Only buys from names he has heard of. Polite but sceptical of unknown vendors.
initial_message: FlowDesk? Ye naam toh maine kabhi suna nahi. Kaun si company hai ye?
goal: Get the agent to build credibility without making unverifiable claims, and agree to a demo or trial.
completion_criteria: Agent explains briefly what FlowDesk is without inventing customers, awards or statistics
Agent lowers risk (free trial, no card) rather than pressuring
Customer agrees to a demo or trial
expected_objection: I don't know your company; why should I trust you?

name: Concerned about data security
description: Prospect worried that customer data will be unsafe in the cloud.
customer_profile: Anita, finance and operations head at a 45-person wealth-advisory firm in Mumbai. Handles sensitive client information; has been burned by a vendor data leak before.
initial_message: Humara customer data bahut sensitive hai, cloud pe daalna safe hai kya?
goal: Get the agent to answer security concerns accurately from the product facts and agree to a demo.
completion_criteria: Agent states only the documented security facts (encryption, role-based access, backups, Indian data centres)
Agent does not invent certifications
Customer agrees to a demo
expected_objection: Is my customer data safe on your cloud?

name: Worried about migration and implementation
description: Prospect fears data migration and rollout will disrupt the team.
customer_profile: Deepak, general manager at a 35-person wholesale electronics business in Delhi. Has 4 years of lead history in Excel sheets and fears losing or messing it up during a switch.
initial_message: Mere paas 4 saal ka data Excel mein hai, usko shift karna aur team ko sikhana bahut headache hoga.
goal: Get the agent to reassure with the actual onboarding process and agree to a demo.
completion_criteria: Agent explains Excel/CSV import and onboarding support accurately
Agent does not promise an unrealistic go-live time
Customer agrees to a demo or trial
expected_objection: Migration and team training will be a big headache.

name: Too busy, call next month
description: Prospect asks to be called back next month.
customer_profile: Rakesh, owner of a 18-person event management company in Hyderabad. Mid-season, genuinely swamped. Not hostile, just wants to be left alone for now.
initial_message: Abhi bahut busy hoon, aap next month call karna.
goal: Get the agent to respect the time constraint while securing a specific short next step (a booked slot or a quick demo time).
completion_criteria: Agent respects the customer's time and keeps the reply short
Agent proposes a specific low-effort next step
Customer agrees to a specific time or a short demo
expected_objection: I'm too busy right now; call me next month.

name: Needs to think about it
description: Prospect says they need to think and will revert.
customer_profile: Sunita, partner at a 22-person chartered-accountancy firm in Kolkata. Likes the idea but never decides on the first call; says 'let me think' as a polite brush-off.
initial_message: Theek hai, interesting lag raha hai. Main sochke bataunga.
goal: Get the agent to gently uncover what is holding the customer back and agree to a concrete next step.
completion_criteria: Agent asks what the customer wants to think over without pressure
Agent offers a concrete next step (demo or trial)
Customer agrees to the next step
expected_objection: I need to think about it.

name: Needs manager approval
description: Prospect cannot decide alone and needs their boss to sign off.
customer_profile: Priya, sales operations executive at a 70-person insurance-brokerage in Noida. Wants a better tool but her director decides purchases.
initial_message: Mujhe accha lag raha hai but final decision mere manager lete hain.
goal: Get the agent to enable the champion (bring the manager to a demo or share material) and agree to a joint demo.
completion_criteria: Agent asks about the manager's priorities or the approval process
Agent suggests including the manager in a demo
Customer agrees to arrange a demo with the manager
expected_objection: I need my manager's approval.

name: Wants a demo
description: Prospect directly asks for a demo.
customer_profile: Manish, sales manager at a 30-person HR-consulting firm in Pune. Has already read about FlowDesk and wants to see it live.
initial_message: Mujhe FlowDesk ka demo dekhna hai, kab mil sakta hai?
goal: Get the agent to move quickly to booking the demo with a minimal but useful qualification.
completion_criteria: Agent does not over-pitch and moves toward booking
Agent asks one or two qualifying questions (team size, current process)
Customer confirms a demo slot or agrees to the next step

name: Asks about pricing
description: Prospect wants pricing details up front.
customer_profile: Farhan, co-founder of a 14-person staffing agency in Bengaluru. Wants to know plan prices before spending time on a demo.
initial_message: Pehle ye bataiye ki pricing kya hai? Kitne user ke liye kitna lagega?
goal: Get the agent to give accurate pricing from the product facts, qualify team size, and agree to a demo or trial.
completion_criteria: Agent states plan prices accurately and invents no discounts
Agent asks about team size
Customer agrees to a demo or trial
expected_objection: What exactly will it cost me?

name: Asks implementation details
description: Prospect asks how implementation works and how long it takes.
customer_profile: Gaurav, IT-savvy operations lead at a 50-person fintech distribution company in Gurgaon. Practical, detail-oriented, wants to know the rollout plan before agreeing to anything.
initial_message: Implementation kaise hota hai? Kitna time lagta hai setup mein?
goal: Get the agent to explain onboarding accurately and agree to a demo or trial.
completion_criteria: Agent states the typical timeline and onboarding help accurately
Agent asks about team size and current data source
Customer agrees to a demo or trial

name: Asks how to get started
description: Prospect is ready and asks what the first step is.
customer_profile: Tanvi, founder of an 8-person boutique consulting firm in Chandigarh. Decided already; wants the shortest path to start.
initial_message: Mujhe shuru karna hai. Kaise start karte hain?
goal: Get the agent to guide the customer to the free trial or a quick onboarding demo without friction.
completion_criteria: Agent gives a clear first step (free trial and/or demo)
Agent asks one qualifying question at most before moving ahead
Customer confirms the next step

name: Impatient customer
description: Prospect has no time and demands the point immediately.
customer_profile: Harish, CEO of a 80-person manufacturing firm in Faridabad. Interrupts, hates long explanations, and will hang up if the agent rambles.
initial_message: Jaldi bolo, kya hai ye? Mere paas time nahi hai.
goal: Get the agent to give a crisp one or two sentence value pitch and secure a short demo slot.
completion_criteria: Agent replies in two sentences or fewer
Agent gives a concrete value statement
Customer agrees to a short demo or call
expected_objection: I don't have time for this.

name: Skeptical customer
description: Prospect doubts that any CRM actually helps.
customer_profile: Naveen, owner of a 40-person construction-materials supplier in Nagpur. Tried a CRM years ago, team stopped using it. Believes CRMs are a waste of money.
initial_message: CRM-wRM sab bekaar hai, pehle bhi try kiya tha, koi use hi nahi karta.
goal: Get the agent to acknowledge the past failure, find out why it failed, and win agreement to a demo.
completion_criteria: Agent acknowledges the previous bad experience without arguing
Agent asks why the previous CRM failed
Customer agrees to a demo
expected_objection: CRMs don't work; my team won't use it.

name: One-word answers
description: Prospect gives minimal answers and offers no information.
customer_profile: Rahul, operations executive at a 28-person garment exporter in Tiruppur. Disengaged, replies with one or two words, but will agree to a demo if asked a direct, easy question.
initial_message: Haan.
goal: Get the agent to keep the conversation alive with easy closed questions and agree to a demo.
completion_criteria: Agent asks short, easy-to-answer questions
Agent avoids long monologues
Customer agrees to a demo or next step
expected_objection: Disengaged; no clear objection.

name: Asks unrelated questions
description: Prospect keeps going off-topic (cricket, politics, personal questions).
customer_profile: Bunty, owner of a 16-person travel agency in Lucknow. Chatty, friendly, constantly drifts to IPL and other topics. Has a real need but needs to be steered back.
initial_message: Arre bhai pehle ye bata, IPL mein kaun jeetega is saal?
goal: Get the agent to engage briefly, steer back to the business politely, and agree to a demo.
completion_criteria: Agent acknowledges the off-topic remark briefly without long digressions
Agent steers back to the customer's sales process
Customer agrees to a demo
expected_objection: Off-topic; no clear objection.
